x: For the Youths, keep in touch with Les Stokell and Tom Carter, they will know all about the fixtures and will advise you of events in which to take part.

Under the guidance of Tom Carter and Les Stokell the lads have made tremendous strides during the winter months. Regular Tuesday evening and Saturday afternoon pack training from the Hall with Tom has brought a tremendous team spirit, and with it an improvement in performance.

Our other men to finish, with nine to compete and six to score, were Les Stokell 64th, Albert Frost 95th, and finally Dick Tobin 132nd. The Southern Champs the following month at Eastbourne at which the Club usually made a strong showing resulted in another 4th place behind T.V.H., Aylesford and Blackheath, our first man home being Les Stokell with a good performance by evergreen Ted Stimpson in 21st place.

Our positions were as follows:- 3 V.S.Blowfield 56:46; 4 E.S.Stimpson 57:24; 7 L.W.Herbert 57:50; 10 F.J.Abberton 58:05; 15 T.P.Clinton 58:20; 36 C.T.Carter 60:01; 38 C.L.Stokell 60:05; 65 R.W.Tobin 61:37; 84 S.R.Eales 62:25; 90 A.E.Frost 62:50; 106 A.F.Mitchell 63:28; 132 G.M.Pearson 64:15.
